nodes.description: Public boolean flag controlling whether minting is enabled; toggled by flipSaleState and checked in mint.
Public price per token in wei (0.004 ether); read in mint for payment validation and writable by setPrice.
Tracks how many reserve tokens have been minted; set to MAX_RESERVE_MINT in claimReserve.
Private mapping used by nextToken to pseudo-randomly shuffle token indices.
Public base URI prefix for token metadata; set by setBaseURI and read by _baseURI.
Constant maximum token supply (4444) returned by maxSupply().
Constant maximum reserve mints (5) used in claimReserve and as offset in nextToken.
Constant cap (10) on tokens minted per transaction, enforced in mint.
Payable public mint function; validates count, sale state, supply and payment, then loops calling _mintPixxo(msg.sender).
Internal pseudo-random index generator that hashes block attributes and mutates tokenMatrix to return a shuffled token id.
onlyOwner function minting MAX_RESERVE_MINT tokens to msg.sender once reserve quota is available.
Internal helper that obtains a token index from nextToken and calls _safeMint(to, index), triggering the ERC721 receiver callback.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites ipfsBase with the provided URI.
onlyOwner function that toggles the saleIsActive boolean.
onlyOwner setter that updates pixxoPrice.
View override returning the metadata URI by concatenating _baseURI(), token id and .json.
Pure getter returning the MAX_MINT constant.
Deploys Pixxo, forwarding payees and five equal shares to PaymentSplitter and requiring exactly 5 payees.
Internal view override returning ipfsBase as the base URI.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used as mint recipient, randomness seed and access-control subject.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable value used as a randomness seed in nextToken.
Pseudo-random index derivation from msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit and block.timestamp (weak randomness).
_safeMint external call to onERC721Received on receiver contracts, an external callback point.
Address.sendValue low-level call forwarding Ether to a payee, transferring control to an arbitrary address.
Caller-supplied mint quantity used in supply, per-transaction and payment arithmetic.
Owner-supplied new price value assigned to pixxoPrice in setPrice.
Owner-supplied URI string written to ipfsBase in setBaseURI.
Token id queried in tokenURI to build the metadata URI.
Recipient address of the minted token inside _mintPixxo.
Constructor payee address array validated for length 5 and passed to PaymentSplitter.
remaining supply computed as maxSupply() - totalSupply() inside nextToken.
hash-derived pseudo-random offset modulo maxIndex inside nextToken.
Result index selected from tokenMatrix and offset by MAX_RESERVE_MINT in nextToken.
Loop counter in mint that iterates n times minting tokens.
Inherited PaymentSplitter release function that computes pending payment, updates accounting and sends Ether.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by mint as the minting recipient passed to _mintPixxo.
msg.sender is one of the attacker-influenceable inputs hashed to produce the 'random' token index.
block.timestamp is hashed into the random index, making token selection time/miner dependent.
mint loops and invokes the internal _mintPixxo helper for each requested token.
_mintPixxo calls nextToken to obtain the token index before minting.
_mintPixxo invokes _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received callback to the receiver contract.
The onERC721Received callback can re-enter mint while state and token accounting are still being updated.
nextToken performs the weak-randomness computation node.
mint reads saleIsActive in its require guard to gate minting.
flipSaleState writes the inverted value back into saleIsActive.
setPrice writes the new price into pixxoPrice.
setBaseURI overwrites the ipfsBase state variable.
_baseURI reads ipfsBase when returning the base URI.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
maxSupply returns the MAX_MINT constant.
nextToken calls maxSupply to compute the remaining index range.
nextToken reads and writes the tokenMatrix mapping to pick and mark used indices.
nextToken offsets the returned index by MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
claimReserve reads and sets totalReserveMint to MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
claimReserve compares totalReserveMint against MAX_RESERVE_MINT and uses it as mint amount.
claimReserve mints reserve tokens to msg.sender.
mint reads pixxoPrice to validate that msg.value covers n * pixxoPrice.
release performs the Address.sendValue low-level call, transferring control to the payee before events complete.
The untrusted n parameter drives the arithmetic totalSupply() + n and n * pixxoPrice in mint.
_price parameter is assigned to pixxoPrice in setPrice.
uri parameter is assigned to ipfsBase in setBaseURI.
_tokenId parameter is checked with _exists and encoded into the returned URI string.
to parameter is the recipient passed to _safeMint inside _mintPixxo.
payees parameter is validated and iterated over in the constructor loop.
maxIndex local holds maxSupply() - totalSupply() used for modulo and tokenMatrix lookups.
random local holds the keccak256 hash modulo maxIndex used as the tokenMatrix key.
offset local stores the resolved index then returned as offset + MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
loop counter i drives the for-loop that mints n tokens.
mint reaches nextToken through _mintPixxo during each mint iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: n is a mint-only argument whose only role is the quantity used by mint's guards and loop.
_price exists solely to be written into pixxoPrice by setPrice.
uri exists solely to be written into ipfsBase by setBaseURI.
_tokenId is only used inside tokenURI for existence checking and URI construction.
to is the recipient argument consumed only by _mintPixxo's _safeMint call.
payees is only consumed by the constructor's length check and PaymentSplitter initialization.
maxIndex is a temporary inside nextToken and has no lifetime beyond that call.
random is a temporary hash result used only within nextToken.
offset is a temporary index resolved and returned by nextToken.
i is the loop counter scoped entirely inside mint.
